project.name: snowmilk
project.description: A café-management application for Sữa Tuyết that records products, ingredients, milk batches, purchasing, daily sales, and inventory.

nodes.name: Product Catalog
nodes.summary: Maintains the café's sellable products and the ingredient records used to describe them. Products can reference a topping ingredient, a size, and a milk batch.

businessRules: Product and ingredient codes are required and unique.
Ingredient category is restricted to supported inventory categories.
crossDomainInteractions: Products reference milk batches for their milk cost basis and ingredients for toppings.
Purchases and inventory use ingredient records.

nodes.name: Recipes, Milk Batches, and Costing
nodes.summary: Records milk-batch recipes with ingredient quantities and costs, then uses those batches in product costing. This creates the cost basis that products and sales estimates consume.

businessRules: Batch ingredient quantity is required and cannot be negative.
Batch ingredient unit cost and amount cannot be negative.
crossDomainInteractions: Provides referenced milk batches to products, sales, and inventory.

nodes.name: Procurement and Ingredients
nodes.summary: Records purchases of ingredients and other items with a purchase date and funding information. Purchase quantities are summarized for inventory calculations.

businessRules: A purchase date and item name are required.
Purchase funding source uses configured supported values.

nodes.name: Sales
nodes.summary: Captures and reviews daily-summary sales records, including product quantities, prices, and variable costs. Daily estimates use products, milk batches, equipment, settings, and sizes as context.

businessRules: Sale-item quantity and unit price cannot be negative.
Daily-sale input is validated before it is saved.
crossDomainInteractions: Reads product and milk-batch context to estimate daily sales.
Sales affect inventory calculations for milk batches.

nodes.name: Inventory
nodes.summary: Calculates ingredient and milk-batch stock for a selected date and stores inventory snapshots. The calculation combines purchase summaries with recipe, batch, and sales information.

businessRules: Quantities are converted using supported units before inventory is calculated.
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes milk-batch and sales data to calculate on-hand stock.

nodes.name: Manage Product Records
nodes.summary: Lists and creates product records through the generic resource API used by the product screen.

nodes.name: Manage Ingredient Records
nodes.summary: Lists and creates ingredient records through the generic resource API used by the ingredient screen.

nodes.name: Record Milk Batch Recipe
nodes.summary: Creates and maintains milk-batch records that embed ingredient quantities, units, unit costs, and amounts.

nodes.name: Calculate Product Costs
nodes.summary: Calculates product costs from the established product, ingredient, and milk-batch information.

nodes.name: Record Purchase
nodes.summary: Creates and manages dated purchase records that identify the purchased item and funding source.

nodes.name: Record Daily Sales
nodes.summary: Validates a daily sales submission, derives its context and estimates, and persists it as a sales record.

nodes.name: Review Inventory
nodes.summary: Returns computed ingredient and milk-batch inventory for a requested date.

nodes.name: Save Inventory Snapshot
nodes.summary: Validates submitted inventory data and stores an inventory snapshot.

nodes.name: Request Product Collection
nodes.summary: Receives a collection request for a registered resource.

nodes.name: Validate Product Resource
nodes.summary: Verifies that the requested resource name is registered before continuing.

nodes.name: Create Product Record
nodes.summary: Accepts a POST request for the registered product resource.

nodes.name: Request Ingredient Collection
nodes.summary: Receives a collection request for a registered resource.

nodes.name: Validate Ingredient Resource
nodes.summary: Verifies that the requested resource name is registered before continuing.

nodes.name: Create Ingredient Record
nodes.summary: Accepts a POST request for the registered ingredient resource.

nodes.name: Define Batch Ingredients
nodes.summary: Stores each recipe line with an ingredient reference, quantity, unit, unit cost, and amount.

nodes.name: Validate Recipe Amounts
nodes.summary: Constrains recipe quantities and costs to non-negative values.

nodes.name: Persist Milk Batch
nodes.summary: Uses the milk-batch model to persist the recipe record.

nodes.name: Load Costing Data
nodes.summary: Uses product, ingredient, and milk-batch data as inputs to costing.

nodes.name: Calculate Costs
nodes.summary: Runs the project's product-cost calculation logic.

nodes.name: Present Costing Workspace
nodes.summary: Exposes calculated costing in the dedicated costing screen.

nodes.name: Enter Purchase Details
nodes.summary: Captures a purchase date, item identity, category, and related purchase data.

nodes.name: Assign Funding Source
nodes.summary: Associates the purchase with a supported funding source.

nodes.name: Persist Purchase
nodes.summary: Stores the purchase record for later reporting and inventory use.

nodes.name: Validate Daily Sale Input
nodes.summary: Validates the request body against the daily-sale schema.

nodes.name: Build Sales Assumptions
nodes.summary: Builds daily-sale assumptions from the available sales context.

nodes.name: Persist Sales Record
nodes.summary: Uses the Sale model to record daily-summary sales.

nodes.name: Resolve Inventory Date
nodes.summary: Uses the requested date or the current Vietnam date as the inventory date.

nodes.name: Summarize Purchases
nodes.summary: Summarizes purchase quantities as an input to inventory.

nodes.name: Calculate On-Hand Stock
nodes.summary: Calculates ingredient and milk-batch inventory from the assembled records.

nodes.name: Validate Snapshot Input
nodes.summary: Validates submitted inventory input before it is accepted.

nodes.name: Store Snapshot
nodes.summary: Persists an inventory snapshot with item quantities and on-hand values.

edges.description: Milk-batch recipes use catalog ingredients, and products reference milk batches.
Purchases identify ingredients maintained in the catalog.
Daily sales context includes milk batches and products.
Inventory calculation includes milk-batch and sales data.
